$comment: Capability and level-profile registry (the "policy registry" of brief 9 section 185, given as an input to the authorization engine by brief 10 sections 212/216). It is policy data, not a grant: a capability listed here is DECLARED and authorizes nothing until an authorization grants it. Effective capabilities are never persisted; they are computed from this registry plus the authorization in analysis.json.

capabilities.description: Read repository artifacts (analysis is impossible without it; carries no mutation authority).
Execute analysis tooling over the repository in place (tools/verify.mjs, tools/checks.mjs, tools/simulate.mjs, tools/validate-analysis.mjs).
Record proposed changes without applying them.
Create documentation (analysis, registers, architecture and roadmap documents).
Modify documentation in place.
Rename a documentation artifact without changing its content.
Move a documentation artifact to another location without changing its content.
Delete a documentation artifact; never granted in this repository.
Create test or harness artifacts.
Modify test or harness artifacts.
Rename test or harness artifacts.
Move test or harness artifacts.
Delete test or harness artifacts.
Create a source artifact.
Modify a source artifact; never granted in this repository.
Rename a source artifact; never granted in this repository.
Move a source artifact; never granted in this repository.
Delete a source artifact; never granted in this repository.
Change an architectural contract rather than an artifact.
Create a commit from the authorized change set.
Publish commits to the remote work branch.

governance.$comment: Moved out of the machine record by brief 10 (the section 209 schema is closed); policy statements about authority live with the policy registry. The prose that explains them is docs/analysis/scope-and-authorization.md sections 3 and 7.

roles.EXECUTOR: same agent, explicitly entering the EXECUTOR role for the authorized change set only

governance.notes: Three canonical grants, all capability-restricted. Content: profile DOC_REFACTOR, mutating capabilities RESTRICTED with explicit path constraints, CAP-DOCUMENT-DELETE denied. Publication: profile PUSH, five capabilities enabled and every content capability that PUSH inherits denied. Extraction (disclosed, not convenient): profile CODE_REFACTOR restricted to CAP-SOURCE-CREATE for change R-001 only, because the extraction created prototype/generic-discovery-engine.user.js and that operation must be represented rather than left uncovered; the capability to modify, rename, move or delete source was never granted, and the artifact digest is unchanged since extraction. No grant authorizes any further work.

record_provenance.$comment: Repository-scope facts that the closed repository object cannot carry (section 209 fixes owner, name, requested_revision, resolved_revision, access_level, included_paths, excluded_paths).

scope_exclusions.gap: end-to-end HtmlProvider behaviour under a real DOM
scope_exclusions.why_required: the headless shim stubs DOMParser, so HTML extraction was verified by matching rules and by code, not by execution
scope_exclusions.proposed_expansion: run the artifact in a browser or a DOM implementation

scope_exclusions.gap: real userscript-manager semantics (redirects, CORS, grants, storage quotas, cross-tab storage)
scope_exclusions.why_required: these determine whether the persistence and scope claims hold outside the shim
